choices: H7.6: a 5m bar's entries (fills at its open) are decided first, on the state at the previous 5m close (equity, open positions, caps); then every open position, the new ones included, runs the bar in the order of H 7.6.

H7.6: a bar whose high (long) reaches the next untried add level fills every add level it reaches first (each moving the stop and the liquidation price), and only then checks the low against the (moved) stop, also when the low had reached the old stop; a bar that reaches no add level checks the stop at once.
H7.6: when the liquidation price lies inside the stop (only possible after a gapped add or a fallback leverage), the low (long) reaching it liquidates before the stop; otherwise the stop exits first.

H7.3: liquidation price = Binance's isolated one-way formula with the bracket's mmr and cum at the position's entry notional; margin per unit = qty x fill / L; funding is paid from / to the wallet, not the isolated margin.
H7.3: no L in 1..20 meeting (i) and (iii) -> the entry is skipped (counted 'leverage').
H7.2/7.4: U stays r x equity at the entry also after a liquidity or margin cut, so S_req uses that U.
H7.3: an entry or add is cut to what the free wallet (wallet - isolated margins) can pay incl. its taker fee; minimum notional is checked on every unit.
H7.5: the 'entry bar' of the chandelier is the signal-timeframe bin that holds the fill 5m bar; the signal bar itself is not included.
H7.6/2: funding at calc_time (rounded to the 5m grid) is charged after the 5m bar ending then; price = the coin's last 5m close; funding at or after the period end belongs to the next period.

H3: a coin whose bars end for good inside the period (manifest last_nonzero_volume_bar) closes its open position at its last 5m close (exit costs, counted 'coin end'); open positions at the period end are marked, not closed.

H8: same 5m fill time -> 30-day quote volume before the signal close (largest first), then pick number, then universe order; a signal whose coin has no 5m bar right after the close fills at the coin's next 5m bar.
H10: months after a bust have M = 1 (account stopped) and are flagged; ln M uses max(M, 1e-12).
H10: 'share of total profit from the top 10% of positions' = sum of the top 10% (ceil) positions' net P&L / sum of all positive net P&L.

H12(a): per coin the n_long + n_short random bars are drawn together without replacement (so one bar is never both sides); the first n_long drawn are long. Pool = the coin's bars with close in the period, label known, ATR14 > 0 and a fill bar inside the period.

H12/H13 seeds: sha256('|'.join(parts)) -> first 8 bytes little-endian -> numpy PCG64; v1 parts (hunt, control, period, r, seed); wide parts (hunt-wide, system id, control, period, r, seed); bootstrap seed = same with 'boot' as the seed part; r written with '%g'.
H13 P0: 'a position open in a month' = at least one position open at some 5m step of that month.
H11.2/W5: 72 / 66 positions = 2 x the period's months; positions = entries opened.

W3.2: a bar with a long and a short event gives no entry and is counted 'both'; F2-F4 warm-up of 300 bars is applied by entries_wide.events_on; the event edge is taken before the gate (a run of True bars that starts on a bar the gate blocks gives no entry later in the run).

W5: picks come from F1-F3 and F5 only (the 686 candidates); the 76 F4 systems run in select as a labelled read (their numbers were chosen after this test period was seen) and never in test, R22 included; the 'no pick' fallback is the best F1-F3 or F5 system.

W7: in the wide study the gate diagnostics run in the select period only (the other gate is a non-pick system); v1 runs them in select and test as H 14 says. In the 'no pick, fail' case the one system's reads run as a pick's.

W7: the first draft's sizing read (r = 2% / 5%) is replaced by the R1 goal board of reads_a.py (machine A: open-risk cap 4% x r / 0.5%, margin budget B = equity / 6 as written; machine B: goal-mode caps).

R24 (engine PR_FIXLEV): the rule bot's tier walk L, L - 10, ... down to 20x; per candidate margin = L% of equity at the previous 5m close, notional = L x margin; taken when the bracket allows L at that notional, the first stop lies inside the liquidation price by max(0.2% of the fill, 1 ATR14) and the loss at the stop (slippage and taker both ways) is <= 15% of equity; no candidate -> skipped ('no_leverage', by the lowest tier's reason in rulebot_skipped). Checked at entry on the planned unit; the liquidity and free-wallet cuts keep L.
H10: select runs report the metric set without the daily equity path (by year / side / group included); test runs include it. DeepSeek rows keep only counts and labels in the repository (W 11).

W3.3: F5 = famous.py's donchian / tsmom states on the system's own bars, day lengths x bars per day of the timeframe; event = the first bar of a state with the state defined on t and t-1; TSMOM decides at bars closing at Monday 00:00 UTC only.

W5/W6: the one-per-name walk runs to 30 names; batches of 10 are fixed in picks.json at select; a batch is tested only when >= 5 of the previous batch PASS; BH within each batch; untested members never run on test.
W12 lineup: computed in the test step from the full figures (DeepSeek: the label and the failing conditions only in public); 'no pick, fail' is excluded.

W7.1 reads: a reads module runs after test.json only when its file is pinned; the hook writes its outputs; any change of a study file while it ran, or a float under a DeepSeek row in its public output, refuses the write; a failed read never changes the test step's result.

H2: data identity = sha256 over the arrays the study reads, in order, each as 'name|dtype|shape' newline then its raw C-order bytes (5m: ts o h l c v qv; funding: ts rate); compared with research/hunt/data_manifest.json at every select / test. Coin end and missing funding months come from that pinned manifest copy; a coin end at or after the period end, and missing months outside the loaded span or after the coin end, are not carried into a step (select keeps nothing about 2024+).

headline_cell.name: R1 headline cell
headline_cell.statistic: share of test calendar months in which a fresh account (start $1,000) touched x5 (marked equity at any 5m close >= 5 x its start)

size_rule: Per row, the (machine, r) cell with the highest mean ln(window multiple) over select calendar months among the cells whose bust share over select calendar months is <= 5% (ties: lower r). Its test row is printed as 'size fixed before the test'; any size read off the test board is labelled 'forward-only evidence'.

out.what: Phase-B autopsy reads O1-O5 (W 7.4a): reported, never a pass; computed after the verdict on the fixed rows; each of O1-O4 counts as one confirm look in the program-wide ledger
choices: Weekend (O1): the signal bar's close in UTC with weekday Saturday or Sunday, i.e. close >= Saturday 00:00 and < Monday 00:00 (a bar closing Saturday 00:00 is a weekend bar; one closing Monday 00:00 is not). The rule is applied to the system's gated signals before the run (a skipped signal is never queued; a later signal on the same coin can then be taken, as when the engine skips one).

'weekend' / 'blackout' counts = gated signals removed (by side); 'base_positions_removed' = distinct positions of the base run whose signal is removed, matched on coin, fill bar and side (signals with the same coin, fill and side share one signal close, so every variant skips all of them or none; each base position counts once).

Controls: the pinned W 6 draws (ctx control_signals, seed parts with r = 0.5%), seeds 1-200, each draw filtered by the same rule on its own signal-bar close and side; a basket's control = each member's draw with the same seed in one wallet (src = pick number). d_m = ln M_m(row) - mean over seeds; the base machine is rerun with the same seeds 1-200 (the pass's 1,000-seed d_m stays in test.json).

Headline shares: fresh $1,000 per UTC calendar month, positions open at the month end closed at the last 5m close (headline convention of reads_a), touch = the engine's 5m peak; at the size fixed on select, chosen per row by reads_a's rule (ctx size_fixed_on_select over the 9 machine A / B cells) on the tested machine's select calendar months; the same cell for every variant; Clopper-Pearson 95%; controls pooled over seeds 1-200.

O2: T = the release time of the FOMC's post-meeting policy statement (scheduled or unscheduled meeting, or a notation vote that issued a policy statement) and of the Employment Situation news release; times in ET converted to UTC with the US daylight-saving rule (second Sunday of March to the first Sunday of November); the statement on longer-run goals (2025-08-22 notation vote) is not a policy statement and is listed as excluded. O2 runs only when research/hunt/macro_calendar.json is in the pin with its current sha256, passes the schema check and every event that can touch a read period is marked verified_official.

O4 (f) and R6 (e): momentum = sign(close[j] - close[j - 20]) on the signal bar's own series (bars of the coin's series, as every lookback); fewer than 20 earlier bars = undefined; 0 and undefined give no entry and are counted. (e) seed parts = W 6's with control 'e' (v1 rows: H 12's), p = hunt.boot_p with the 'boot' parts, seed rank = (1 + seeds with mean ln M >= the row's) / (n + 1). Label rule applied to pick and v1 rows.

Select-only map: the select step's data cut (every coin's 5m bars and funding before the select end; the coin end as load_coin sets it), hunt's own system_signals / run_signals / wide_eligible / wide_choose, base cost and cost x2 at r = 0.5% with the weekend rule; F4 never; the map's picks are compared with picks.json's members. Per timeframe (all four, also where no tested row exists): systems, eligible, median score and picks with weekends (the select step's own rows: select.json, DeepSeek rows from the private select file) and without (the map), and per system the change of score; the official members are also rerun with weekends on the cut data and compared with select.json (the map is like for like only when they agree). Public: money figures over non-DeepSeek systems; private: all.
D11: rows that contain a DeepSeek pick and F3 rows of the map keep labels and counts in public (floats dropped); all figures in the private file.

The copy is a reads-only engine option in a reads file, held to the standard W 7.2 sets for the engine read options inside hunt.py.

Identity test (W 7.2 standard): on seeded synthetic coins, the copy with the side cap off returns every output of hunt._engine bit-identical (equity, trades, skip, cut and add counters), with the stress ledger off and again with it on, at machine A and machine B cells and for a basket; the module also stores the sha256 of hunt.py and refuses to run when it differs, so the copy can never drift from the pinned engine.

Side cap: one extra parameter SIDECAP (a fraction of equity; 0 = off). A first unit is taken only if the open risk of every open position on its side, across all coins, plus q x D0 stays <= SIDECAP x equity at the previous 5m close; an add only if that side's open risk of the other positions plus the position's risk after the add (the engine's own add check, with the moved stop) stays <= the same limit. Open risk = the engine's _risk (sum q x (reference fill - current stop), shorts mirrored), the measure the total cap PR_CAP already uses. Skipped entries and adds are counted as 'side_cap', first units and adds separately, exported like the other skip reasons. SIDECAP = half of the cell's PR_CAP at every cell: machine A at r: 0.5 x 4% x r / 0.5% (r = 0.5%: 2%; 1%: 4%; 2%: 8%; 5%: 20%; 10%: 40%; 20%: 80%); machine B at r: 0.5 x min(4r, 60%) = min(2r, 30%) (5%: 10%; 10%: 20%; 20%: 30%). The headline board at the size fixed on select uses that cell's SIDECAP.

Stress ledger (decision path untouched): at every 5m close, per side, S_g = sum over open same-side positions of q x (close - stop x (1 - g)) for longs and q x (stop x (1 + g) - close) for shorts, g = 0, 0.05, 0.10 (the loss from the close to the current stop, plus a 5% and a 10% gap through it); per side and g, the maximum of S_g / equity at that close and its 5m step (date) are exported. The trade list cannot give it: it has no stop path, no add fill times and no add quantities (adds can be cut by the margin budget or the free wallet).

Then O3 = O1's summary on the side-capped machine (both periods, controls (a) / (b) seeds 1-200 through the same cap, the R1 headline shares at the size fixed on select) plus the stress line for the base and the capped machine. reads_o3.py's line is appended to the pin before it runs. If it is never built, O3 (named in W 7.4a before the pin) is recorded in DEVIATIONS.md as not computed.
